description: A Forgejo repository a consumer's content lives in: who may edit it.

repoEditors.description: Forgejo usernames given write access to the consumer's repository. A person signs in to Forgejo once (with Authentik) before they can be added; until then the service warns and adds them on a later update.
repoEditors.note: Forgejo admins (Authentik group forgejo-admins) reach every repository already. Removing a name from the list does not take access away; do that in Forgejo.
repoEditors.changeNote: Adds collaborators to the repository; the consumer's VM is not touched.
